name: music_timing
description: Timing accuracy test — fast notes at known tempo, measures actual vs theoretical emission times
script: # Start timing capture, play fast pattern, stop, analyze
# === Test 1: 8 notes/cycle at 1 cps (8 notes/sec, 125ms apart) ===
strudel [c4 d4 e4 f4 g4 a4 b4 c5]*1 cps=1
# === Test 2: 16 notes/cycle at 1 cps (16 notes/sec, 62.5ms apart) ===
strudel [c4 d4 e4 f4 g4 a4 b4 c5]*2 cps=1
# === Test 3: 4 notes/cycle at 2 cps (8 notes/sec, 125ms apart, double tempo) ===
announce 3/3: 4 notes at 2 cps (125ms intervals, higher tempo) — capturing...
strudel c4 e4 g4 c5 cps=2
announce Check godot log for TIMING analysis
notify {SCRIPT} "Timing tests done. Check log for analysis." ["OK"] {inspect} blocking
